   179	class DummyVectorizer:

   182	    def __init__(self, max_length=100, n_gram=2):

   185	        self.P = 10**9 + 7  # A large prime number

   187	        self.coeffs = [random.randrange(1, self.P) for _ in range(n_gram)]

   189	    def _hash(self, gram):
   190	        """Hashes a string using a polynomial hash function."""
   191	        h = 1
   192	        for coeff, c in zip(self.coeffs, gram, strict=False):

   194	            h %= self.P
   195	        return h % self.max_length
   196	
   197	    def __call__(self, texts: list[str]) -> np.ndarray:
   198	        vecs = []
   199	        for text in texts:
   200	            grams = [text[i : i + self.n_gram] for i in range(len(text) - self.n_gram + 1)]
   201	            vec = [0] * self.max_length
   202	            for gram in grams:
   203	                vec[self._hash(gram)] += 1
   204	            vecs.append(vec)
   205	
   206	        vecs = np.array(vecs, dtype=np.float32)
   207	        vecs -= np.mean(vecs, axis=1, keepdims=True)
